messages.subject: Code with different colors
parts:
Hi

I am preparing some lecture notes using R Markdown

I want to know if is it possible to make different lines of code with different colors inside chunk

I have several lines of code that are repeated in every slide and I would like to separate them by color from new code

Thx

messages.author: c2a4124666613378
messages.subject: Re: Code with different colors
parts:
Hi,

I don't believe there is anyway to achieve that in knitr/markdown directly.

Probably the most straight-forward way would be to post-process the output and wrap each section you want to highlight in a <div> block and assign it a CSS class with the settings you would like to use.

Best,
Keith
